owned_library_import.evidence: Exact frozen candidate 7a17b24 passed import, export and restore for seven owned adventures and three reference books with zero warnings.

clean_standard_user.evidence: Owner explicitly confirmed Gate 1 completion in conversation on 2026-11-09; no additional OS build is asserted.

backup_restore.evidence: Offline backup of the prior app was restored in isolation. The frozen 0.3.2 candidate rendered the unified book and mixed player tabs. A second restore preserved grouped navigation, 29 native journal entries, 11 missions, original files and saved map fog.

privacy_audit.evidence: Windows run 44826883447 passed the explicit product boundary. The independently downloaded artifact passed exact commit, version, tree digest, ZIP checksum and every-file manifest validation. Private sources and backup evidence remain outside the public project.

frozen_browser_e2e.evidence: Exact Windows run 44826883447 passed the full source and frozen browser suites and portable ZIP smoke. Targeted regressions cover persistent left navigation, imported and prepared tabs in one player screen, frame isolation, showing and closing tabs, preserved fog and a missing optional prepared map.

owner_main_pc.evidence: The owner reported Player Screen and navigation issues on the installed 0.3.1 build and requested the reviewed corrections as a new regular release. Their prior desktop acceptance remains recorded. Additional Windows hardware testing is deferred.

private_hosting.evidence: Remote-origin player/API tests and a simulated slow Tailscale launcher verified local startup responsiveness, private access validation and graceful Serve cleanup. Existing physical browser acceptance is recorded under 0.3.0.

second_device_browser.evidence: Owner confirms the private link opens the campaign and PHB, DMG and SCAG from the main-PC browser with Tailscale connected. This verifies cross-device browser access; it does not claim a clean VM, exhaustive hardware/geometry testing or concurrent-edit acceptance.

gate_1.note: Owner explicitly confirmed Gate 1 complete. Additional Windows build/account details were not supplied.

publication.reason: Owner requested a reviewed regular release that fixes cross-source presentation and brings the campaign journal and resources together.

deferred.laptop_compatibility: Other physical-device/browser acceptance has not been performed; same-host automated Tailscale HTTPS checks are recorded separately.
deferred.full_visual_geometry: Every source map has not undergone complete visual/geometry acceptance; review imported maps before presentation.
